name: sr-exit-chunk5-sea
_comment: The Score Mandate's session exit of September 28, 2026 (second exit that day) — Chunk 5's SEA evidence arm, for SR-5b/SR-5c and the reserve. Over twelve turns it: prices and raises a naval yard (NV-D9); sets a hold aside with a fought attack (SR5B-2) and keeps a march through a refused attack (SR5B-1); throws the Grand Diversion, is refused inside the four-turn wait, and throws it again at the readiness the blockade has left (SR-5c); commissions a 5,000-man corps and quotes a landing with its levers (AAR-D7); and lays keels. Run with --turns 12 --diplomacy decline (Britain's armistice would reopen every port). `turns` keys are the driver's 1-based LOOP INDEX (PC15-H).
_note_sf6x2: SF6-X2 (Score Finish Step 6, October 4, 2026): Oudinot marches to the NORMANDY yard (one march from Paris, the descent arm's yard) — the Bordelais road crossed Paget's Peninsula corps at Guyenne once the board drifted, so he reached the yard on loop 9, after both landing lines, and the digest read SCRIPT PRECONDITION (naval F2).
_note_t0i: T0-I (November 7, 2026, the SF6-X2 precedent again): the post-S14j boot chest is 800, so the loop-1 yard (1,200g) and the loop-4 commission (3,500g) were both refused, the Oudinot lines fell to unknown_name clarifications whose first answer REWROTE Soult's Bordelais march, and both landing lines were refused — naval F2 red on staging, not on the navy. Re-staged to the chest's own curve: the yard at loop 4 (the chest crosses 1,200 at T3), the commission at loop 8 (crosses 3,500 by T7 with margin), the march at 9, the landing at 10-11, keels after the commission.
